plazas.name: Plaza Tol Jambatan Pulau Pinang (Perai)
plazas.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penang_Bridge ; PLUS API JPP (car 5.74, motorcycle class 0.00, queried 2026-10-22) ; https://www.mof.gov.my/portal/arkib/media/2018/dis/Siaran%20Media_%20Pembekuan_Kenaikan_%20Kadar_Tol.pdf
plazas.note: Charged only mainland->island (westbound). Motorcycle toll (was RM1.40) abolished 2019-01-01 (MOF 2018-12-27 release). OSM '(unnamed 5.36,100.39)' (4 booths, 5.35674,100.39297) sits on the same plaza and is probably part of it.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Jambatan Kedua (JK2PP, Batu Kawan collector lanes)
plazas.highway: E28 Sultan Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah Bridge
osm_names: Plaza Tol Jambatan Sultan Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah
plazas.note: Bridge toll is charged one way only, mainland->island (westbound). History: RM8.50 -> RM7.00 (2020-01-01) -> RM5.74 (18% cut, 2020-02-01). In the 2026 rate-freeze list (no rise in 2026). No 20% Penang-resident discount on this bridge. Through (express-lane) traffic from the NSE pays the SAME RM5.74 bridge toll at Bandar Cassia Plaza A instead of here, so charge it once per westbound crossing, at whichever plaza the route passes. Motorcycles (was RM1.70) free since 2019-01-01. 50% festive discounts occur (e.g. CNY 2026-02-14/15) - ignore.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Bandar Cassia (Penang 2nd Bridge integrated plaza, link-road component)
plazas.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sultan_Abdul_Halim_Muadzam_Shah_Bridge (fare table 'since 1 February 2020', citing PLUS open-system fare table)
plazas.note: Link-road toll RM0.60 is collected in both directions together with the PLUS closed-system fare (westbound at Plaza A/B, eastbound on exit). Westbound Plaza A ALSO collects the RM5.74 bridge toll. The PLUS API code is BCS (exit Plaza A) / BKW (Plaza B); BCS-BCS returned empty, so use PLUS pair fares for NSE<->Bandar Cassia trips and do not double-count the 0.60.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Tanjung Kupang (Second Link)
plazas.note: Car 6.14 confirmed (off-peak rate ended 2023-03-01). Motorcycle toll (was RM1.10) abolished 2019-01-01. DIRECTION NOT VERIFIED from an official source: a 2017 traveller report (littledayout.com) paid at Tanjung Kupang both entering and leaving Malaysia, Wikipedia's Second Link article labels it 'heading into Malaysia'. Both-directions chosen as the safer (over-estimating) default. The 2023 gazette table also lists a 'Sultan Abu Bakar Complex' (CIQ) toll of RM8.68 for cars (MOF 2018 'Plaza Tol CIQ' RM10.60 x0.82); which traffic pays it is unclear and it is not in the OSM data - not included.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Bangunan Sultan Iskandar (Causeway CIQ, PLUS component)
plazas.note: Only the PLUS toll remains; the EDL toll collected at the same building ended 2018-01-01 for all vehicles (not a Malaysian-vehicles-only change). No later abolition found (2026 Hari Raya discount reports still list BSI as a charging plaza). Motorcycles: no toll found (sgmytaxi lists '-'). Direction: believed charged both entering and leaving (the 2014 cross-border toll dispute involved both directions), but not confirmed by an official page - medium/low.

plazas.name: Kubang Semang Toll Plaza (BKE)
plazas.source: PLUS API KSG=1.31, KSG<->LUN=2.62 (2026-10-22) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butterworth%E2%80%93Kulim_Expressway ; https://www.plus.com.my/our-expressways/ (dedicated motorcycle lane)
plazas.note: Open system, both directions. Motorcycles free (separate motorcycle lane). Concession was extended to 2038 (parliament reply 2016); PLUS still operating BKE in Oct 2026, so the June-2026 end date on Wikipedia is stale.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Lunas (BKE)
plazas.note: Open system, both directions; a through trip pays both BKE plazas (RM2.62).

plazas.name: Perai Toll Plaza (BORR)
plazas.note: Class 1 per official LLB page. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia; LLB page lists no motorcycle class). Open system; both directions assumed (OSM has 2 booths/carriageways; no source states one-way) - direction medium. BORR is on the 2026 rate-freeze list.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Bagan Ajam (BORR)
plazas.note: Class 1 per official LLB page. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia; LLB page lists no motorcycle class). Open system; both directions assumed (OSM has 2 booths/carriageways; no source states one-way) - direction medium. BORR is on the 2026 rate-freeze list.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Sungai Nyior (BORR)
plazas.note: Class 1 per official LLB page. Motorcycles free (Wikipedia; LLB page lists no motorcycle class). Open system; both directions assumed (OSM has 2 booths/carriageways; no source states one-way) - direction medium. BORR is on the 2026 rate-freeze list.

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Gombak (KL-Karak)
plazas.note: Open barrier plaza on mainline, both directions. Motorcycles free. Concessionaire is now AFA PRIME Berhad (formerly ANIH; anihberhad.com is a hijacked spam domain - do not use).

plazas.name: Plaza Tol Bentong (KL-Karak)
plazas.note: Open barrier plaza on mainline, both directions. Motorcycles free.

closed.name: Senai-Desaru Expressway (closed system)
closed.source: https://www.sde22.com/toll-fare (official 'Closed System Toll Fares' image, fetched 2026-10-22; site (c) 2025) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senai%E2%80%93Desaru_Expressway
closed.note: Open and operating; fares symmetric (table lists both directions identically). Motorcycles free. SDE is on the 2026 rate-freeze list. 'Ulu Tiram Toll Plaza' (OSM operator 'SNI') is the SDE Ulu Tiram interchange plaza next to the SDEB HQ (KM22, 1.585075,103.813333). Senai Town I/C (west of Senai plaza) and the Pasir Gudang Link beyond Cahaya Baru plaza have no further plazas in the fare table. Cahaya Baru-Penawar section is being widened (contract 2024, due 2027).

closed.name: East Coast Expressway LPT1 (Karak-Jabor, AFA PRIME) + LPT2 (Jabor-Kuala Terengganu, LPT2 Sdn Bhd / PLUS) - integrated closed system
closed.source: Karak-Kuantan 19.60: https://afa.group/kenaikan-kadar-tol-bergantung-kepada-kerajaan/ (concessionaire, 2024-11-29) + https://www.motorist.my/article/2829/ (2026-05-22). Other LPT1 pairs: hargatariif.my 2024 table (site now offline; seen only via search snippets) and hargakosmy.com (Karak-Gambang 16.90, 2025-12-31), said to match the 2014 ANIH brochure. Karak-Kuala Terengganu 39.24: motorist.my 2026. Jabor-KT 18.24 = 39.24 - 21.00 (derived; also = 2016 rate 12 sen/km x 0.82 cut). Cheneh-KT 16.15 = 2016 RM19.70 (Bernama/BH 2016-07) x 0.82 (derived). 18% cut on LPT2 from 2020-02-01: https://mof.gov.my/portal/ms/berita/siaran-media/diskaun-18-tol-plus-bermula-tengah-malam-ini
closed.note: Closed (ticket/TnG) system; entry at Karak, exit anywhere up to Kuala Terengganu; pairs assumed symmetric. Motorcycles free (separate free entry/exit lanes). Pair fares are from non-official aggregators (LPT1 rate frozen at 12 sen/km since 2018; no increase found up to Oct 2026) - treat as medium for Karak-Kuantan, low for the rest. LPT2 pairs other than those listed NOT verified: LPT2 Class 1 rate is 12 sen/km x 0.82 = ~9.84 sen/km of tollable distance since 2020-02-01, but plaza-pair km are not published, so no per-pair numbers are given. LPT2 is on the 2026 rate-freeze list. Wikipedia's RM43.27 Karak-KT and calculatormalaysia's RM41.90 are pre-2020 figures. OSM '(unnamed 4.06,103.31)' (4.06376,103.31396) between Jabor and Cheneh is probably the Kuantan Port (Pelabuhan Kuantan, exit 837) interchange plaza - no fare found. Gombak/Bentong (KLK) are separate open plazas - see plazas list.

abolished.source: https://paultan.org/2018/01/02/toll-collection-ends-at-batu-tiga-and-sungai-rasau-in-selangor-bukit-kayu-hitam-in-kedah-and-edl-in-johor/ ; https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2017/10/295804/ ; plaza demolished and road handed to JKR Kedah (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North%E2%80%93South_Expressway_Northern_Route)

Lanang Bridge toll (Sibu, Sarawak) - not in OSM data
Tun Salahuddin Bridge toll (Kuching, Sarawak) - last Sarawak toll; not in OSM data
Motorcycle tolls at Penang Bridge, Second Penang Bridge and Second Link (Tanjung Kupang) - cars still pay

not_road_tolls.verdict: Not a highway toll: single booth on Jalan Dedap 4, Taman Johor Jaya (Nominatim reverse); no tolled road there. Likely a car-park/estate guard booth. Pasir Gudang Highway (FT17) has no toll plaza in any source found.
Wang Kelian, Perlis (Thai border, pedestrian way) - not a road toll.
Kinabalu Park summit-trail gate, not a road toll.
Penang ferry fare booth, not a road toll (ferry fare is out of scope).
Campsite fee, not a road toll.

notes.sabah_sarawak: No road toll plaza is collecting in Sabah or Sarawak as of 2026-10-22 as far as found: Sarawak abolished its three bridge tolls in 2015 (Lanang, ASEAN/Batang Baram for Malaysian vehicles) and at midnight 2015-12-31 (Tun Salahuddin); the Pan Borneo Highway is toll-free by federal policy (Utusan 2019-01). No Sabah toll road was found.
notes.rate_freeze_2026: Govt froze 2026 rates on 10 highways incl. SDE, LPT2, LLB/BORR, Sultan Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah Bridge, GRANDSAGA, LATAR, NNKSB, SKVE, DUKE, MEX (paultan.org/bm/2025/12/19/...).
notes.plus_api_motorcycles: PLUS API class index differs per plaza: for JPP, class 0 = motorcycle (0.00), 1 = car (5.74), 4 = 9.84 (Penang Bridge class 3A). Other plazas return empty for class 0.
